record.question: Spirulina is a rich source of:
options: Fibre that can be used as a bulk laxative
Iron and folic acid and can be used to treat anaemia
Mecobalamin and can be used in peripheral neuropathy
Proteins, vitamins and minerals and is considered a 'super food'
record.explanation: Answer D: Proteins, vitamins and minerals and is considered a 'super food'. Spirulina is a biomass of cyanobacteria containing protein and micronutrients; the broad nutrition option is the best fit, although “super food” is not a scientific category. Source/context note: Do not treat “superfood” as a regulated or evidence-graded medical claim. Reference: https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/WeightLoss-HealthProfessional/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
